title: Monomial Moving Zeros for the Heat Semigroup: An Explicit Finite-Order Differential Hierarchy
summary: Let $P_t=\exp(t\D^2/2)$ be the heat semigroup. For every integer $k\geq2$ and parameter $ρ\in\C$, we construct an entire function $Γ_{ρ,k}$ whose heat evolution has the prescribed moving zero $x=ρt^k$ and constant spatial flux there: \[ (P_tΓ_{ρ,k})(ρt^k)=0, \qquad \partial_x(P_tΓ_{ρ,k})(ρt^k)=1. \] The initial function is explicit, \[ Γ_{ρ,k}(x) =x\sum_{q\geq0}\frac{(-2^kρx^{2k-1})^q}{q!} \frac{(kq)!}{((2k-1)q+1)!}, \] and is a generalized hypergeometric function whose entire-function order is strictly below two.
